title: App crashes on login
text: Every time I tap Sign In with Google the app closes immediately on iOS 17. This started after the last update.
label: Bug Report

title: Dark mode for dashboard
text: It would be great to have a dark theme option for the analytics dashboard. My eyes hurt during late-night reviews.

title: Screen reader cannot read chart labels
text: VoiceOver skips the bar chart labels in the reports page, so I cannot understand the data without sighted help.

title: How do I export CSV?
